shock.goldTest: Gold whipsaws: sold with risk assets first, then the haven bid if funding stays calm. The test is whether funding spreads widen; while they do not, this is risk aversion, not a liquidity squeeze.
shock.competing: A dollar funding squeeze building underneath (SOFR−EFFR and the FX swap basis would widen next), or forced de-grossing of crowded positions.

channels.name: Real-rate opportunity cost
channels.obs: 10Y TIPS 2.60%, −3 bp on the week, −32 bp over 4 weeks
channels.cannot: The level alone does not forecast daily returns; the regime-dependent sensitivity is read from changes, and a nominal yield move is not a real-yield move.

channels.name: Inflation expectations
channels.cannot: Breakevens carry inflation-risk and TIPS-liquidity premia; a hot print is not mechanically bullish for gold if real yields and the dollar reprice higher.

channels.name: US dollar
channels.obs: DXY 102.36, +0.27% on the week, +0.13% over 4 weeks · broad USD −0.10% over 4 weeks
channels.cannot: USD and gold can rise together under stress or fall together when cash is wanted; gold in EUR, JPY, INR and CNY terms is not checked here, so the USD quote may hide a different local story.

channels.name: Central-bank path
channels.obs: 2Y 4.46%, −15 bp on the week, −31 bp over 4 weeks · 10Y−3M 0.67%
channels.cannot: The 2Y mixes expected policy and term premium; a cut that was priced is not a dovish surprise, and the reaction to a decision is the signal, not the decision.

channels.name: Risk, safe haven and liquidity
channels.obs: VIX 28.2 (VIX/VIX3M 1.10) · HY OAS 3.48%, +22 bp on the week · SOFR−EFFR 4 bp
channels.cannot: Safe-haven behaviour is conditional: in a liquidity squeeze gold is sold for cash first (BIS WP 1380: the effect depends on financial conditions). An inverted VIX curve is stress, not a direction.

channels.cannot: COT is a Tuesday snapshot of reportable futures, published Friday: crowding and fragility context, not direction. ETF tonnage and options dealer positioning are not observed by the council.

channels.name: Official reserves and physical demand
channels.obs: not observed by the council (WGC monthly reserves run two months in arrears; quarterly demand is partly estimated)
channels.cannot: Reported reserve values rise with the price; value growth is not purchases. Exchange stocks, London vaults and ETF metal are different inventories and must not be added.
